clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 7 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have minimum average annual turnover of Rs 7 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have 3 years of past experience in same or similar service.

clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from turnover and experience criteria.

clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from experience criteria.

clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate
clauses.summary: Seller must upload an OEM Authorization Certificate along with experience, past performance and turnover documents.

clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking experience/turnover exemption must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.quote: EMD Detail R /Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 30000
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 30,000 is required.

clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking EMD exemption must submit valid supporting documents with the bid.

clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers/service providers get EMD exemption; traders are excluded.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications. If the bidder is DPIIT Registered OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also
clauses.summary: DPIIT registered startups are relaxed from bidder turnover and, if OEM, from OEM average turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate of turnover must be uploaded with the bid.

clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government organisations/PSUs for the specified number of years.

clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted to prove supply in each financial year.

clauses.heading: 10. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 10% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 10% of bid quantity of similar products to government/PSU in one of the last three financial years.
